events.title: Woodstock Festival Took Place 57 Years Ago
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Festival took place in 1969, featuring some of the biggest names in music.

angles.name: Woodstock Anniversary
angles.copy: It's been 57 years since the iconic Woodstock Festival changed music history, featuring legendary acts like Jimi Hendrix and The Who.

events.title: Anniversary Of Elvis' Death
events.blurb: Elvis Presley passed away on this day in 1977.

angles.name: Elvis Tribute
angles.copy: Today we remember the King of Rock 'n' Roll, Elvis Presley, who passed away on this day in 1977, leaving behind a legacy of incredible music.

events.title: Tupac Shakur Shot Dead In Las Vegas 30 Years Ago
events.blurb: Tupac Shakur was shot dead in Las Vegas on this day in 1996.

angles.name: Tupac Tribute
angles.copy: Today we remember the life and music of Tupac Shakur, who was tragically shot dead in Las Vegas 30 years ago, leaving behind a powerful legacy.

events.title: Anniversary Of Jimi Hendrix' Death
events.blurb: Jimi Hendrix passed away on this day in 1970.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: Today we pay tribute to the legendary Jimi Hendrix, who passed away on this day in 1970, but left an indelible mark on the music world.

events.title: Beatles Release Abbey Road 57 Years Ago
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album Abbey Road on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Anniversary
angles.copy: 57 years ago, The Beatles released one of their most iconic albums, Abbey Road, featuring some of their most beloved tracks.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde Turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' lead singer Chrissie Hynde turns 75 today.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday
angles.copy: The Pretenders' iconic lead singer Chrissie Hynde turns 75 today, with a career spanning decades and countless hit songs.

events.title: Liam Gallagher Turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis' lead singer Liam Gallagher turns 54 today.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday
angles.copy: The voice of Oasis, Liam Gallagher, turns 54 today, with a career marked by unforgettable hits and unapologetic style.

events.title: John Lennon Released Imagine 51 Years Ago
events.blurb: John Lennon released his iconic album Imagine on this day in 1971, but the single was released in 1971 and the album in the US in 1971, however the UK release of the album was in 1971 but after the US single release, to avoid confusion the UK release date of the single is not used, instead the US release date of the album is used as this is also the date the album was available to the global market.

angles.name: Imagine Anniversary
angles.copy: 51 years ago, John Lennon released his powerful and poignant album Imagine, featuring the iconic title track that continues to inspire generations.

events.title: Apple Released The First iPod 25 Years Ago
events.blurb: Apple released the first iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionizing the way we listen to music.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: 25 years ago, Apple released the first iPod, changing the music landscape forever and paving the way for a new era of portable music players.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Today is James Bond Day, celebrating the iconic spy created by Ian Fleming.

angles.name: James Bond Day
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day, the perfect excuse to indulge in a martini (shaken, not stirred, of course) and revisit some of the most iconic Bond films.

events.title: John Lennon Would Have Been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon would have been 86 today, had he not passed away in 1980.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: Today we remember John Lennon, who would have been 86, a visionary musician, poet, and peace activist who left an indelible mark on the world.

events.title: John Cleese Turns 87
events.blurb: Comedy legend John Cleese turns 87 today.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: The comedic genius John Cleese turns 87 today, with a career spanning Monty Python, Fawlty Towers, and countless other iconic roles.

events.title: Beatles Release 'White Album' 58 Years Ago
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking 'White Album' on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 58 years ago, The Beatles pushed the boundaries of music with the release of their innovative 'White Album', featuring a diverse range of genres and styles.

events.title: Anniversary Of Freddie Mercury's Death
events.blurb: Queen's lead singer Freddie Mercury passed away on this day in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Today we remember the incomparable Freddie Mercury, who passed away 35 years ago, leaving behind a legacy of unforgettable music and captivating performances.
